blocked.reason: Number agreement breaks at the singular boundary: PermitTimer.tsx formats {time} as '${m}m', so with exactly 1 minute remaining the string renders 'Quedan 1m — cierre el permiso pronto' — plural verb 'Quedan' with a singular quantity. The English source '{time} left' is number-neutral, but the Spanish verb-first construction is not, and this key has no .one/.other plural forms to absorb the case.
blocked.failedLens: Mechanics: {var} sets identical per key; .one/.other pairs complete and grammatical; no empties/truncations; caps/ellipses/em-dashes consistent with English intent; doNotTranslate tokens untouched

blocked.reason: Dropped condition: English source is "Add rescue plan for PFAS" but the Spanish back-translates as only "Add the rescue plan" — the PFAS qualifier that tells the worker the rescue plan is tied to personal fall arrest use is silently dropped, while sibling strings (rescuePlanRequiredPfas, errRescuePlanPfas) retain it.
blocked.failedLens: Safety accuracy: blind back-translation diff (dropped conditions, softened imperatives, flipped negations, weakened permit/legal meaning)
